main.description: 10% Public Fund tithe counterpart record. Emitted alongside payment.sent when purpose = donation. Per ADR-2605192130. economic.tithe_to_public_fund_bps = 1000 (constitutional constant, ADR-2605192100 §2).

originalSentUri.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.apps.payment.sent record this tithe is derived from.

titheAmountUsdcMicros.description: USDC base units (6 decimals) of the 10% tithe (= grossAmount × titheBps / 10000).

titheBps.description: Tithe rate at time of routing in basis points. Always 1000 (= 10.00%) under current constitution.

grossAmountUsdcMicros.description: Original gross donation amount before split.

netAmountUsdcMicros.description: Amount that landed at the original recipient (= gross - tithe).

publicFundAddress.description: 0x-prefixed Public Fund Safe address on Base L2 (= Constitution.getMutable('public_fund.safe_address')).

titheRouterAddress.description: TitheRouter.sol contract address that emitted the Routed event.

txHash.description: TitheRouter.route() tx hash on Base L2.
